	Day 5	Activity		08/06/2026					Svolvær	"Svolvær: Photo Tour Henningsvær & Haukland Beach |09:30 | 7 hrs  Pick up / meeting point
Svolvær Tourist Information office, Torget 18

Overview
This extraordinary 7-hour Winter Photography Tour of the Lofoten Islands will guide you through a journey to the best locations, allowing you to witness the mesmerizing Arctic lights. Take unforgettable pictures and better understand the rich culture connected to the region.

What's included?
Pick-up/drop-off in central Svolvær
Knowledgeable, English-speaking guide
Private minivan transportation
Professional photos & instructions
Small group, maximum 7 adults
Coffee or tea to keep you warm

What to expect?
Explore the wonders of the Lofoten Islands, a small archipelago located 200 kilometers above the Polar Circle, renowned for its Arctic lights and breathtaking colors. Join our daily photography tour as we search for the best light and locations to capture unique and unrepeatable pictures.

The islands, inhabited since the Viking age, offer unforgettable sights, from majestic nature with steep peaks rising from the sea to pristine white-sand beaches and vivid blue waters that defy Arctic expectations.

Our tour takes you to the wild and untamed Atlantic side, where Haukland Beach's tropical beauty and Utakleiv's surfer's paradise are just some of the natural wonders awaiting you.

Immerse yourself in the rich history, culture, and folklore of the Lofoten islands by visiting ancient fishing hamlets like Nusfjord and Henningsvær. These fantastic fishing villages hold a glorious past, with picturesque architecture and a profound connection to fishing during the Middle Ages.

Guided by our English-speaking expert, you'll have ample time to admire and photograph the enchanting scenery, breathing in the Arctic atmosphere. The tour's duration varies based on lighting conditions, with a focus on allowing you to enjoy and capture fantastic pictures.

The Lofoten Islands' amazing nature, unique light, and complex history have drawn famous photographers and artists from around the world, inspiring awe-inspiring artwork."
	Day 6	Activity		09/06/2026					Svolvær	"Svolvær: Trollfjord Cruise & Sea Eagle Safari by Catamaran |10 AM | 3 Hrs  Pick up / meeting point
Svolvær Harbor, Torget 22

Overview
Join us on an unforgettable journey from Svolvær to the legendary Trollfjord, one of Norway’s most dramatic natural wonders.

What's included?
Knowledgeable, English-speaking guide
Sightseeing and sea eagle watching
Light fishing experience during the tour
Unique piece of digital art as a memory
Comfortable thermal suits and lifejackets
We serve homemade fish soup for lunch
Warm coffee, tea, and snacks

What to expect?
Discover Lofoten’s wild beauty aboard Arctic Queen

Join us on an unforgettable journey from Svolvær to the legendary Trollfjord, one of Norway’s most dramatic natural wonders. On board Arctic Queen, our elegant 44-foot yacht, you can experience Lofoten’s magic at your own pace: deep blue fjords, the open sea, and steep mountains rising straight from the water.

The first photo shows Arctic Princess gliding quietly into the narrow entrance of Trollfjord, where steep granite walls rise from the sea and the Arctic light colors the landscape in soft tones of gold and blue.

This trip is more than ordinary sightseeing. It is a journey into the heart of Northern Norway. As we leave Svolvær harbor, we pass small fishing villages, quiet bays, and untouched landscapes that have inspired Arctic explorers and artists for generations.

When the sea eagles appear, everything seems to pause. Their wings spread wide above the cliffs as they circle effortlessly over the fjord. You will have the chance to watch them up close, wild and powerful.

If you like, we can stop for a bit of light fishing. Arctic Queen carries simple gear, and with some luck we may catch cod or pollock fresh from the sea. If we do, we will prepare it on board so you can enjoy an authentic taste of Lofoten.

As we approach the narrow entrance to Trollfjord, surrounded by towering peaks, the atmosphere becomes almost unreal. It is a place where silence and grandeur meet, where nature dominates, and where old stories feel alive.

On the return to Svolvær, we cruise slowly while you enjoy coffee, tea, and local snacks on deck or in the cozy saloon. From the flybridge, you can enjoy wide views of the fjords and islands, giving you a front-row seat to one of Norway’s most beautiful landscapes."

	Day 8	Activity		11/06/2026					Tromso	"Tromsø: Accessible Fjord Tour of Kvaløya & Sommarøy incl. Lunch | 10 AM | 5 hrs 

| Overview
On this tour we will travel in our minibus around the fjords of the island of Kvaløya, nearby Tromsø, and enjoy a nice lunch on Sommarøy island.

What's included?
Pick-up/drop-off in central Tromsø
Knowledgeable, multilingual guide
Free photographs from the trip
2-course meal with coffee or tea

What to expect?
The tour starts at the meeting point. From there we will drive west, crossing the bridge that connects Tromsø to the island of Kvaløya.

During this trip we will cross 3 fjords. And we will drive across the valley of Kattfjordeidet. There will be short stops to take photos and experience nature. Sometimes we can see reindeer and other animals roaming free.

The destination is Sommarøy, “the Summer Island”. There we will enjoy a warm lunch inside the Sommarøy Arctic Hotel.

To return we will take the road on the south-east coast of Kvaløya. During this ride we can enjoy the views of the Sund and the mountains of Malangen.

The tour finishes at our original meeting point after approximately 5 hours.

In all our tours we accept wheelchair users or people with reduced mobility. We also are prepared to guide people with visual or hearing impairments. And we always work on creating a comfortable experience for neurodivergent people as well."

What to expect?
Uncover the secrets of the city with this guided tour. Take a stroll on the cobblestone filled streets through Stockholm’s Old Town and delve into the deep history of the Swedish capital. Explore the “city of islands” from the marine point of view on a 10min ferry trip. Let your guide take you on a walk on Djurgården to the Vasa Museum, the legendary flagship of the Swedish Navy.

Start at a easy to find central location: Gustav the III obeilisk / Slottsbacken obliisk.
Experience the rich history of Stockholm’s Old Town.
* Enjoy the striking views of the city from the water.
* Visit the Vasa Museum

On this trip you’ll explore old town stockholm visiting or passing by all major points of interest: Stockholm palace, Storkyrkan, main square Stortorget, Riddarholmen, house of knights, experience the smallest ally in Stockholm, the metal statue of St George and the dragon in Old town, a boat trip and short guided walk trough Djurgården isle passing by Viking Museum, museum of wrecks, Liljevalls and the former navy quarters galärvarvet ending with a guided tour in the world famous Vasa Museum."

	Day 13	Activity		16/06/2026					Copenhagen	"Copenhagen: Forest Tower & Forgotten Giants Day Tour | 10 AM | 5.5 Hrs| Pick up / meeting point
Colbjørnsensgade 15, Copenhagen

Overview
TIME Magazine named the Forest Tower one of the 100 greatest places to visit worldwide in 2019. Enjoy a visit to this architectural masterpiece, set in the heart of one of the country’s most scenic forest landscapes.

What's included?
Pick-up/drop-off from central Copenhagen
Transportation by air-conditioned minibus
Guided visit to Copenhagen Forest Tower
Guided visit to The Forgotten Giants site

Not inlcuded :Entrance ticket to Forest Tower
Food and drinks are excluded

What to expect?
Visitors follow a 1.2‑kilometer elevated wooden boardwalk that winds gently through the treetops. The path leads to the Forest Tower itself, a striking 45‑meter spiraling structure rising above the canopy. Walking the tower’s curved ramp offers a calm, panoramic ascent where the forest opens up step by step. At the top, the 360‑degree view stretches across rolling woodlands, lakes, and fields, making it one of the most photogenic spots in Denmark. Many travelers describe standing on the summit of this “wooden skyscraper” as a highlight of their entire trip.

The Forgotten Giants: A Modern Fairy Tale Hidden in Nature

The “Forgotten Giants” are a beloved outdoor art treasure scattered around the outskirts of Copenhagen. Created by Danish artist Thomas Dambo, the project features six enormous wooden sculptures built entirely from recycled materials and locally sourced scrap wood. Each giant is placed in a quiet, natural setting - meadows, forests, lakesides - encouraging visitors to explore lesser‑known green areas around the city.

Every sculpture has its own personality and story, and part of the charm is the sense of discovery. They are intentionally hidden, turning the visit into a playful treasure hunt for adults and children alike. On this tour, we visit two of these impressive giants, giving you time to walk around them, appreciate the craftsmanship, and enjoy the peaceful surroundings where they rest.
"
